'''Twintan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] Pureblood [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Inquisitor|Inquisitor]] and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]].
